title: Seagrove Beach "Ocean Pearl" 67 S Ryan Street
h1: Seagrove Beach "Ocean Pearl" 67 S Ryan Street
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gulf views- Beach Access Only 50 Steps Away- 2 Community pools- 5 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforters, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Ocean Pearl is a modern 5-bedroom, 5.5-bathroom coastal home that sleeps 13 in the Seagrove Beach community of Scenic 30A. With more than 3,300 square feet and 2 living areas, this retreat is perfect for large families and friends. Enjoy beautiful views of the Emerald Coast from all 3 floors—with beach access only 50 steps away!Welcome to the heart of this stunning 3-story home. The great room, with a contemporary open floor plan, exudes modern flair and style. Sink into the comfortable furnishings, all situated around a large TV and a cozy fireplace in the living area to enjoy some quality time. Prepare culinary masterpieces in the kitchen, showcasing all new high-end appliances and countertops. Take a seat in the beautiful dining area, entertaining up to 10 guests, with the spacious island seating for 4 more. Off the living area is a luxurious ground-floor guest bedroom with a king bed and a private bathroom. Step outside through 3 sets of French doors and discover a covered porch with a picnic table, outdoor grill, and Adirondack chairs. It's the perfect place to listen to the waves crash.Retire to the second-floor bedrooms, all with private bathrooms, at the end of the night. The primary bedroom boasts a king bed and a private balcony offering breathtaking views of the Gulf. The guest bedroom features a king bed, while the second guest bedroom offers a queen bed queen sleeper sofa. There's a laundry room on this floor.Experience authentic coastal living on the third floor, featuring a luxurious private king bedroom with a private bathroom and breathtaking beach views. A built-in daybed in the top-floor living area provides space for lounging or accommodating an additional guest. The lovely deck will amaze and enchant with its unparalleled sunset views. Guests rave about this floor being the best spot in the house!Ocean Pearl truly has it all, including Gulf views, proximity to 2 community pools—a family pool and adults only—and a quick 2-minute walk out the back gate to the nearest beach access at the Ramsgate walkover. It's easy to get around with on-site parking for 5 vehicles plus 5 complimentary adult bikes. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 13):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub Separate with Gulf Views- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed with Queen Sleeper Sofa, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyTHIRD FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed and Built-in Twin Daybed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub Separate*Please note that there is current construction nearby.
